Table S5: Coefficients from fitted Bayesian linear regression model between proportion of amphibian genome composed of recently active Ty3 elements and genome size. Elements were considered recently active if integrated genome sequence had less than 10% divergence from Ty3 RepeatModler consensus sequences. Estimated 𝜆 for the relationship was zero.
Table S6: Count of Open Reading Frame Diamond BlastP Hits to Pol Polyprotein Components

Table S7: Coefficients from fitted Bayesian negative binomial regression model between count of open reading frame (ORF) blastp hits to retroviral Pol polyprotein from putatively full length Ty3 elements and genome size. Elements were considered full length if they were greater than 90% of the RepeatModeler consensus sequence and greater than 4,000 bp. Count includes ORFs that were identified as either integrase, protease, reverse transcriptase, or Pol polyprotein. ORFs were found using ORFfinder with full length TY3 elements as input.
